A few months ago, I posted here looking for people to join our kindergarten team, and through this group we were lucky enough to meet some truly amazing people who became part of our team. So I thought I’d try my luck here again 😊

My partner and I run an English-speaking kindergarten in the heart of Tel Aviv, and we’re currently looking for someone warm, responsible, and motivated to join us for the upcoming school year.

We know that finding the right job when you’re starting a new chapter in Israel isn’t always easy. Several members of our team have gone through, including my partner, or are currently going through, the immigration and citizenship process themselves, so we’re very familiar with the challenges that can come with building a new life here.

Previous experience in education or working with young children is definitely a plus, but for us, finding the right person is just as important.

The position is Sunday through Thursday, plus one Friday a month. We offer good working conditions, a great team, and a warm, supportive environment.

If you love working with children and are looking for a place where you can grow, feel at home, and hopefully stay for the long term, feel free to send me a private message for more details. 🌿
